control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at CY-3212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CY-3212 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 29 May 2008 a near hit was recorded on CY-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
